title: A Multi-LLM Debiasing Framework
findings: The proposed multi-LLM frameworks, particularly the decentralized approach, significantly reduced stereotype-based bias in the religion category compared to a single-model baseline. For instance, using a combination of GPT-4 and llama3-70B, the decentralized method reduced the bias score for religion from a baseline of 0.196 to 0.062.
